parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The idempotency token. Ensures that repeated requests do not execute the same operation more than once.

parameters.name: FinalizeRestore
parameters.description: Specifies whether to complete the restoration immediately. Default value: false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Specifies the region in which to query or perform the operation.

parameters.name: RestoredBranchName
parameters.description: The name of the restored branch. If not specified, the backend generates a name automatically.

parameters.name: RestoredLsn
parameters.description: The snapshot LSN used for restoration.

parameters.name: TargetBranchId
parameters.description: The target branch ID. If not specified, the backend selects the target branch based on the restoration process.
